title: IdpTopupBalance
description: Platform extension of TopupBalance: adds tenantId. TMF654 has no characteristics, so it also carries rechargeType and the agreement reference.

tenantId.description: The tenant the resource belongs to (platform extension).

rechargeType.description: Kind of recharge (canonical recharge_type); TMF654 has no characteristics.

agreement.description: The agreement the recharge applies to (canonical agreement_id).
